# Toggle group

A set of toggles where one or many stay pressed.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Multi-brand</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-toggle-group--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:light" title="Toggle group examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-toggle-group--docs">Open Toggle group in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-toggle-group--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Multi-brand:** Monthly or yearly prices.

- **Use it when:** Switching a view or a mode between a few options, such as list and grid.
- **Not when:** A form answer (radio group), or actions (button group).

Instead:

- [Radio group](./radio-group.md): An answer in a form.
- [Button group](./button-group.md): Actions, not a pressed choice.

## Words

- Shared structure: object, state, next step.
- Brand tone lives in headlines and marketing copy, not in errors.
- Errors and confirmations read the same in every brand.
- Use: Get started, Plan, Order. Avoid: Brand-specific words in errors, Jargon.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Get started

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Arrow keys move between toggles. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It is a group with a name; each toggle says whether it is pressed. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add toggle-group
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Variables

Every token Toggle group reads, from its code: the variable, the semantic token it aliases, and where that ends in the theme.

### Read straight from the system

Toggle group has no variables of its own yet; it reads these system tokens directly.
